currentTwLabel: 財務成本、其他利益及損失

definition.zh-TW: 本業以外的支出，例如借款的利息與遞延資產的攤銷。模板的分組標題；台灣報表把這些項目分成財務成本與其他利益及損失。
definition.en: Costs that arise outside the main business, such as interest on borrowings and amortisation of deferred assets. A template group heading; Taiwanese statements split these into finance costs and other gains and losses.
